datasets.title: Global inter-calibrated nighttime lights - NTLs
datasets.description: Global inter-calibrated nighttime lights (NTLs) have been generated from stable NTL annual composite product (version 4) using a novel 'Ridgeline Sampling and Regression' method (Zhang et al., 2016). Before use, all images will need to be re-scaled by multiplying pixel values with a scaling factor of 0.01. For more information, refer to Zhang et al. (2016) [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog climate-risk-stac (https://climate-risk-data.github.io/climate-risk-stac/)]
